releaseNotes:
🌟 What’s new

• Compact mascot bubbles across Ticketek, Marketplace and Ticketmaster, keeping your preferred address and language. Show details expands the full status message.
• Added a separate Activity Log tab with timestamps, Copy log and Clear log. Switching to the log does not interrupt the run; Stop remains available.
• Ticketmaster low-demand monitoring can watch all sections found in the event map, including inactive ones. Search sections, select all or clear, and set individual section prices or apply a price to a group.
• Added ANY quantity with optional odd quantities and singles. Starts at the largest permitted quantity, steps down after confirmed failures and repeats on the same matching listing.
• ANY with even quantities follows a repeating sequence such as 8 → 6 → 4 → 2 → 8. Only quantities permitted by the listing are tried; fixed quantity stays fixed.
• Auto-refresh availability is ON by default: 30 seconds, adjustable from 10 to 3,600 seconds. Monitoring resumes on the same event after its automatic refresh; manual reloads require a new Start.
• Monitoring selections, quantity options and price limits are saved separately for each event. Added refresh countdown and last-checked time.

🛠️ Improvements and fixes

• Fixed NZ resale ticket-name verification when the panel includes an additional seating description.
• Refresh pauses during reservation attempts. Uncertain responses, held tickets, checkout, verification and access blocks stop further actions.
• High-demand Ticketmaster filters and existing Ticketek/Marketplace ticket-selection behaviour remain unchanged.

Reload the extension and refresh your ticket tab after updating. Only native loaded listings are scanned; Ticketmaster’s quantity and ticket filters can hide listings even with ANY selected. Area groups require confirmed mapping; other map sections stay under Other sections. Prices are per ticket and separate checkout fees may apply. Checkout remains manual.
